Company Description
 👋🏼 We're Nagarro. We are a digital product engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world, with 18,000+ experts across 39 countries . Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical, empowering our people to take ownership, collaborate openly, and create meaningful impact.
 Job Description
 We are looking for a talented Mobile Developer to join our team and help build and enhance innovative mobile solutions. You will play a key role in developing high-quality applications, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and leveraging modern AI-assisted development practices to deliver exceptional user experiences.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a collaborative environment, building scalable solutions, and staying at the forefront of modern software development.
 Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native, JavaScript, and Kotlin. 
Design and implement user-friendly, responsive, and high-performance mobile experiences. 
Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Developers, and other stakeholders to refine requirements and define technical solutions. 
Write clean, scalable, maintainable, and well-documented code. 
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and usability across various devices and screen sizes. 
Implement application monitoring, analytics, and performance tracking. 
Support application localization and multilingual experiences. 
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
Maintain and update technical documentation, operational procedures, and internal knowledge bases. 
 Qualifications
 Technical Skills
Strong experience with React Native. 
Solid knowledge of Android SDK. 
Experience with Kotlin. 
Strong understanding of JavaScript. 
Experience developing and maintaining mobile applications for Android. 
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
Experience working with JIRA and Confluence. 
Proficient in using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) in day-to-day software development. 
Skilled in prompt engineering, AI-assisted problem solving, and validation of AI-generated code and content. 
Experience applying AI across the SDLC while balancing automation with sound engineering judgment. 
 Nice to Have
Experience with iOS SDK development. 
Knowledge of cross-platform mobile architecture and best practices. 
Experience with application analytics and monitoring tools.
